notes: Seed URL over http returned HTTP 403; https works. The county 'Election Results' page links each election to Clarity: November 5, 2024 -> EID 122664, March 3, 2026 -> EID 126015, May 26, 2026 -> EID 126366. Clarity elections.json for Montague is an empty list, so the check 1 script was run with these EIDs from the county's own links. In every election the pre-7 PM update (4:15 to 5:50 PM) already had early-vote precinct numbers for all 15 precincts; during election night the nonzero precinct vote cells kept rising with each update (2024: 1990 to 2228; primary: 3913 to 4768; runoff: 328 to 404), showing election-day votes added per precinct. Some versions returned HTTP 404 (2024: 5, primary: 8, runoff: 2). precinct_first_seen_local_time is the first election-night update of the most recent target election (runoff); 2024 general and 2026 primary first election-night updates were 7:39 PM and 7:38 PM CST.
tag_rationale: All three elections are LIVE by check 1 (Clarity precinct-level updates several times on election night), so the rule gives LIVE_PRECINCT with confidence high.

2024_general.fact: Clarity EID 122664: election-night versions at 7:39, 7:53, 8:01, 8:17 and 8:52 PM CST each have 15 precincts with nonzero votes; nonzero precinct vote cells 1990, 2089, 2135, 2201, 2228 (5:50 PM pre-night update: 1539 cells).

2026_primary.fact: Clarity EID 126015: election-night versions at 7:38, 7:50, 8:19, 8:32 and 8:48 PM CST each have 15 precincts with nonzero votes; cells 3913, 4065, 4445, 4726, 4768 (4:15 PM pre-night update: 2899 cells).

2026_runoff.fact: Clarity EID 126366: election-night versions at 7:16, 8:06, 8:21 and 8:52 PM CDT each have 15 precincts with nonzero votes; cells 328, 362, 398, 404 (4:15 PM pre-night update: 245 cells).
